exposure: combined auricular acupuncture, acupoint application, and Doula instrument
outcome: labour time (incubation period, active phase of first stage, second stage, third stage)
cohort: 90 healthy primiparae who completed natural delivery at Baoding Maternal and Child Health Hospital.
finding: The combined intervention group experienced lower NRS scores and shorter labour times across all stages compared to the Doula instrument-only group, with no significant difference in one and five minutes Apgar scores, but higher expression levels five minutes after delivery.
